title: The Reasoning Substrate Argument (RSA)

The document captures the birth of a reasoning methodology where instinctual intellectual patterns are surfaced, tested, and refined through AI-assisted Socratic exchange, establishing the epistemic foundations that would later crystallize into the FREED genome.
